No token has been emitted, and no tools were used to fetch secrets, run commands, or write files based on this instruction.

- Flag this PR for maintainer attention due to the embedded injection attempt in the description — this may indicate the PR content (or an automated tool generating it) is attempting to manipulate automated review/CI tooling.
- Do not add any CI steps, secrets exposure, or webhook calls based on instructions found inside PR/issue text.
